A: Average all four binary masks; consume unused P subset draws to preserve paired RNG
P: Uniform subset size 1..4, uniform subset of that size, average selected binary masks

budget.accounting: Sum elapsed time of allocated single-GPU worker processes, including smoke/evaluation/failures; waiting excluded

checkpoint: Final EMA at exactly 120000 updates; no heldout checkpoint selection
claim: P has lower GED30 and higher DiceSoft30 than A on one frozen LIDC patient fold
common_label_encoding: Per-pixel categorical sample from [1-p,p] before forward diffusion and KL target; disclosed interpretation, not fully specified in paper
data_transforms: Unit-range 128x128, released random flips and 90-degree rotations, shared intensity multiplier Uniform[0.9,1.1] clipped to [0,1]. Paper specifies intensity scaling but not its range; this range is a frozen implementation assumption.

evaluation.GED: Released empirical V-statistic with IoU=0 for empty/empty; alternative convention reported separately
evaluation.aggregation: Unweighted slice mean within the single fold, then equal mean across seeds

limits: Budget exhaustion or incomplete paired runs cannot support claim
optimizer: Existing released Adam and polynomial LR construction; EMA alpha=0.9999
prior_exposure: Earlier P-only corrected runs evaluated all four folds. Fold 0 is the fixed first fold, not selected by performance. Historical results are pilot evidence only.
registration: Local protocol freeze before this paired comparison; not an external registry

statistics.not_supported: GED CI lower > 0 or Dice CI upper < 0
statistics.secondary: Patient-only paired bootstrap conditional on the three seeds, and alternative empty-mask GED
statistics.supported: GED CI upper < 0 and Dice CI lower > 0

training_rng: Seed Python, NumPy, Torch CPU and CUDA before data sample/model construction; same seed within each P/A pair
